repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
wait until((#Y_Mot).motionSensor_motion == false)
fired = false
}
wait until((#Y_Mot).motionSensor_motion == true)
(#Y_Siren).siren_setSirenMode("police")
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a rising-edge wait (blocking until `Motion == true` then firing once). The candidate polls the condition at the start of the body (t=1000ms) using a periodic `if`. At t=100ms, the condition became true, but the candidate did not act because its guard was evaluated at the wrong instant. The rearming logic (`triggered`) was correct, but the observation point must be inside a blocking wait, not a periodic check.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` polling pattern with the standard rising-edge state machine: initialize `fired`, block until the condition is false (rearm), block until the condition is true (fire), execute the action, and mark `fired`. This ensures the action occurs exactly when the edge rises, matching the IR.
